scenario: Multiple activations at the same clock instant fire in activation-creation order per LDET.5.5. Two facts matching the same rule fire in assertion order: item asserted first fires first. Pin: assert 'a' then 'b'; pump; log messages appear as ['a', 'b'].
rules_ds:
schema Item scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule r:
    Item i
->
    log critical "{i.entity_id}"
